steps.u: Add CSV export for a project's tasks: GET /projects/:id/tasks.csv, only for members of the project.

steps.r:
class TasksController < ApplicationController
  before_action :authenticate_user!
  before_action :load_project

  def index
    @tasks = @project.tasks.order(:position)
  end

  private

  def load_project
    @project = current_user.projects.find(params[:project_id])
  end
end

steps.a: `load_project` already scopes to `current_user.projects`, so non-members get ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound (404). I'll add a `format.csv` branch to `index`, streaming the rows with `find_each` to keep memory flat for big projects.

i.new_string:
def index
    @tasks = @project.tasks.order(:position)
    respond_to do |format|
      format.html
      format.csv do
        headers['Content-Disposition'] = %(attachment; filename="#{@project.slug}-tasks.csv")
        self.response_body = TaskCsvExporter.new(@project.tasks.includes(:assignee)).each_line
      end
    end
  end

i.content:
require 'csv'

class TaskCsvExporter
  HEADER = %w[id title status assignee due_on].freeze

  def initialize(scope) = @scope = scope

  def each_line
    Enumerator.new do |y|
      y << CSV.generate_line(HEADER)
      @scope.find_each do |t|
        y << CSV.generate_line([t.id, t.title, t.status, t.assignee&.name, t.due_on&.iso8601])
      end
    end
  end
end

require 'rails_helper'

RSpec.describe 'Tasks CSV export' do
  let(:project) { create(:project) }
  let(:member) { create(:user, projects: [project]) }

  it 'returns CSV for members' do
    create(:task, project:, title: 'Write intro')
    sign_in member
    get project_tasks_path(project, format: :csv)
    expect(response.media_type).to eq('text/csv')
    expect(response.body.lines.first).to eq("id,title,status,assignee,due_on\n")
    expect(response.body).to include('Write intro')
  end

  it '404s for non-members' do
    sign_in create(:user)
    get project_tasks_path(project, format: :csv)
    expect(response).to have_http_status(:not_found)
  end
end
